rules:
Second-backbone replication, ROUND 2: training length adapted per backbone.
Why: in round 1 (results/courtdyn/backbone2/verdict.md) both SmolVLM2-2.2B and Qwen2.5-VL-3B,
trained with the Qwen3.5-4B recipe for one epoch, gave <= 2 distinct metre answers in most test
cells, so R1/R2/R4 were LIMITED (untestable). Round 2 asks whether that was under-training.
Round-1 verdicts stay reported; round 2 is added, never substituted.

RECIPE. Identical to round 1 (same pools event_holdout_v3 / mixunit_v3, lr 1e-4, cosine, warmup
0.03, grad_accum 16, LoRA r 16, max_pixels, seed 42, nf4 evaluation) except that the schedule is
num_train_epochs = 4 (280 optimizer steps) with a checkpoint at the end of every epoch (70 steps).
"Epoch k" means the step-70k checkpoint of that 4-epoch schedule. Nothing else is tuned.

DEV SET (used only to choose k). The 280 Q1_side_0-30 items (140 path, 140 speed) of
results/courtdyn/courtdyn_native_sft_train.json, training wording, metres. They are in neither
round-2 training pool and are not a test cell. Disclosure: Q1_side shares its event window with the
test cell Q1_top_0-30 (different camera). To limit any leverage, the stopping statistic uses only
answer diversity and parse rate, never accuracy, rank agreement or the reference values.

STOPPING RULE. k* = the smallest k in {1, 2, 3, 4} at which the metre-only (v3) adapter, on the dev
set, has parse rate >= 0.90 AND >= 5 distinct parsed answers in EACH of the two families.
If no k qualifies, k* = 4 and the backbone is reported as "degenerate at the 4-epoch cap" (a scale
boundary under this recipe); the test cells are still evaluated at k = 4, descriptively.
The mixed-unit adapter is trained on the same 4-epoch schedule and used at the same k*; it is not
selected separately.

TEST AND VERDICTS. Same test cells as round 1: {Q1_top_0-30, Q2_top_480-510} x {speed, path},
explicit (E) and in-template (T) arms, first-frame x4, text probe. Base-model results of round 1 are
reused (same weights, same inputs). Rules R1, R3, R4 exactly as round 1
(results/courtdyn/backbone2/PREREGISTRATION.json, rules_sha256 42ed2ead...). Degeneracy as applied
in round 1: R1 cell degenerate if metre OR centimetre arm has <= 2 distinct answers; R2 on the
centimetre arm; R4 needs a non-degenerate full-frame metre arm and rho defined in both conditions.
R2 is AMENDED for round 2, before any round-2 run, because round 1 showed that two unit priors
100x apart pass R2 without any image reading: a cell counts toward R2 "replicates" only if R >= 10
AND Spearman rho(centimetre answers, reference) >= 0.30. R2 "fails" if >= 3 non-degenerate cells
have R <= 3. Anything else intermediate; fewer than 3 non-degenerate cells LIMITED.

INTERPRETATION fixed now. Claims are scoped per backbone. A backbone that passes the stopping rule
and replicates R1 and R4 supports "order is read, units are not" beyond Qwen3.5-4B. A backbone
degenerate at the cap supports only a scale-boundary statement. No test-cell result may change k*.
